title: Structural pullback of a tensor section across a square
statement: For a scheme morphism g:Y to X [def-pc-scheme], modules F on X and G on Y [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and a morphism psi:g*F to G [def-pc-module-pullback], define the additive map on tensor sections across a commutative square p:V to U above g [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. It is the global-section unit for p, followed by normalized tensor composition for p and U.hom, transport along p followed by U.hom equals V.hom followed by g, the inverse normalized composition for V.hom and g, and the V-pullback of psi. This is the existing qcoherentPullbackSection definition, relocated without changing its type or body. No sheaf morphism or cohomology square is asserted here.

proof.text: Compose the canonical additive global-section unit, the two normalized tensor composition isomorphisms and equality transport, followed by the additive map induced by psi. Each arrow has the required source and target. This is a real construction from the fixed tensor-pullback adjunctions; it does not select data from a new existence assertion.

def qcoherentPullbackSection {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (ψ : (tensorPullback g).obj F ⟶ G)
    (U : X.Etale) (V : Y.Etale) (p : V.left ⟶ U.left)
    (h : p ≫ U.hom = V.hom ≫ g) :
    Γ((tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤) ⟶ Γ((tensorPullback V.hom).obj G, ⊤)
